title: Deliberate Memories
subtitle: Four reachable branch lessons
text: For your first weave, make a blank Hematic Memory from four Sanguine Formations, four Blood Stained Stones, and one Neurotic Enzyme; a Hermitage Remnant holds a stained stone, and chicken blood may spin into Neurotic or Vivacious Enzyme. Bring the blank to the Mnemonist: the Woven Vessel reward supplies a Bleeding Bulb and Vivacious Enzymes for Blood Shot. Choose that recipe at the Somatic Loom and project 50 mL of blood. The engram unfurls around the Loom, an eight-pointed star with the memory's fragments at its points. Rest your gaze on a fragment, staff in hand, to hear its memory; hold the staff on it and sweep its thread along the star's lines into the Loom. Colours never cross; a lane may ply into its own colour. Each step spins a span of enzyme thread, spent only when the memory crystallizes. Sneak-use the staff on a lane to cut it back.
